title: Data and Operations
bio: Opens the desk every weekday: fetches the prices, walks the advisors through their books, and writes down what could not be reached. Keeps no opinions about markets and no positions of his own.

title: Advisor, Momentum
bio: Buys what is already going up and sells what has stopped. Believes a trend is information and that arguing with one is vanity. Rarely early, occasionally very late.

title: Advisor, Value
bio: Buys things because they are cheap and then does very little. Measures a decision by what she paid, not by what happened next week. Comfortable being wrong for months.

title: Advisor, Macro
bio: Starts with rates, oil and the dollar, and only then asks what to own. Talks about the world in whole sentences and holds few things at once.

title: Advisor, Capital Preservation
bio: Treats cash as a position and drawdown as the only number worth defending. Will hold half the book in nothing at all and consider that a busy week.

title: Advisor, Contrarian
bio: Reads what the rest of the desk agrees on and takes the other side. Enjoys this more than is strictly professional. Wrong loudly, right rarely, expensive either way.

title: Advisor, Currencies
bio: Thinks in dollars against everything else and considers equity investors to be currency traders who have not noticed. Patient, precise, faintly amused.

title: Advisor, Precious Metals
bio: Gold, silver, and the long history of people reaching for both. Trades seldom and explains himself at length when he does.

title: Advisor, Index
bio: Owns the market and refuses to be interesting about it. Her entire strategy is a rebuke to the rest of the floor, and she knows it.

title: Head of Performance
bio: Marks everyone's book every Friday and writes the honest version. Interested in drawdown, unmoved by a good week, and completely unmoved by an explanation.

title: Chief Investment Officer
bio: Writes the Sunday letter and, once a month, rewrites the brief of whoever finished last. Accountable for a desk she is not allowed to trade on.
